description: This file defines a React Native component for displaying a year-in-review/wrapped summary in the Notesnook app, including multiple slides with stats, charts, and sharing functionality.

classes.name: Slide
classes.description: A simple component for centering slide content with specified width.

classes.name: WelcomeSlide
classes.description: A slide welcoming the user and introducing the year-in-review.

classes.name: TotalNotesSlide
classes.description: A slide displaying total notes created in the year.

classes.name: TotalWordsSlide
classes.description: A slide displaying total words written in the year.

classes.name: ActivityStatsSlide
classes.description: A slide showing activity stats like most notes created in a month/day.

classes.name: MostUsedTagsSlide
classes.description: A slide showing most used tags.

classes.name: MostActiveNotebooksSlide
classes.description: A slide showing most active notebooks.

classes.name: SummarySlide
classes.description: A comprehensive summary slide with charts and stats.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number into a compact string with suffixes like K or M.
